subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw define a session-owned temporary model lease for `/model --turns N`, and should it unify with the one-turn model override work in #83565/#100876?
rationale: The request changes command UX, Gateway API shape, persisted session state, provider/auth validation, and config defaults, so the permanent contract is a maintainer product/API choice rather than a deterministic bug fix.

options.title: Specify unified lease contract first
options.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share session state, provider/auth validation, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

options.title: Limit scope to one-turn override
options.body: Keep this issue open or close it only if maintainers intentionally decide OpenClaw should support one-shot model overrides but not N-turn leases or configured turn limits.

options.title: Preserve sticky selection only
options.body: Reject temporary model leases and direct users to existing persistent `/model` selection plus manual `/model default` cleanup.

recommendation.title: Specify unified lease contract first
recommendation.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share session state, provider/auth validation, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior work on model override, auth handling, and live-switch behavior across the session/provider boundary.
